content.short: Dark Frontiers is a P2E space survival MMORPG with its own in-game cryptocurrency, $DARK.
content.description: Dark Frontiers is an action MMORPG built around Play-to-Earn mechanics and immersive, dark fantasy space exploration. Survive on stark, breathtaking planets that are cold, lifeless, and not meant for humankind, testing your reflexes, combat skill, and ingenuity to the limit. Across a shattered alien empire, riches beyond your wildest dreams are guarded by monsters from your darkest nightmares. Quest, explore, and earn your way to victory among the stars.
content.meta: Dark Frontiers is an action Play 2 Earn MMORPG in a dark fantasy space setting. Discover Dark Frontiers and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
